title: Library Overdue Penalty Calculation
scenario: Find the top 3 most frequently overdue books per genre. Use DENSE_RANK to handle ties.
tableSchema: loans (loan_id INT, book_id INT, genre VARCHAR, overdue_days INT)
hint: Group by genre and book, count overdues, then rank.
correctQuery: SELECT genre, book_id, overdue_count FROM (SELECT genre, book_id, COUNT(*) AS overdue_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rnk FROM loans WHERE overdue_days > 0 GROUP BY genre, book_id) t WHERE rnk <= 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE loans (loan_id INT, book_id INT, genre VARCHAR, overdue_days INT);
